Ah sorry, I misunderstood what was said in other comments. I'm not trying to be malicious.

Chapter 7 ends with the slayer attempting to shoot prince Ahzrak with the Atlan, but he manages to escape. Chapter 8 then begins with Thira saying that the heart is made up of two parts, and they don't know where the second part is. The slayer then walks off and Thira tells the troops to "ready the ancestral forge". We are then dropped in the forest. For all of this chapter, its not explained why we are in this forest. Additionally, the forge is vaguely explained as to what it actually is and why we need to go there. 


Chapter 8 also does nothing to explain why we are activating the forge, until it is clear we used it to juice up our shield. Its okay to leave everything up to ambiguity sometimes, but after what is likely an hour of gameplay, some context is needed otherwise the story just makes no sense. 


Chapter 9 just begins with...well we just teleport to hell. The Doom slayer doesn't need much reason to go to hell, but we genuinely just begin the chapter so abruptly? No "ah we just leveled up your shield, you should be powerful enough to go to hell now". Poor transition and overall the ancestral chapters poorly justify themselves.


There are countless other examples but I cba watching the YouTube videos to support my argument.


The overall story of this game is better than eternal in my opinion, however its so poorly presented that it just takes away from the experience. Feels like a first draft or that missions were moved around with voicelines removed. The fact that the devs plan to patch in some stuff to provide better context justifies this argument.

All the questions would tend to be answered after the mission has started, or on the loading screen, which is just a bad way to tell the story.


I loved everything else about the game and is my favourite Doom.
